name: Caspar Asset Management S.A.
summary: Caspar Asset Management S.A., founded in 2009 and based in Poznan, Poland, delivers comprehensive asset management solutions. The company serves both individual investors and institutional entities across key markets, including Western Europe, the United States, and Poland. Their service portfolio includes offering access to diverse financial instruments, facilitating the execution of buy and sell orders, and providing expert investment consulting. Furthermore, Caspar Asset Management S.A. is actively involved in the establishment and oversight of investment funds, as well as the distribution of their respective units.
